question: Does current main or the #7589 proposal observe hard-health invalidation that arrives in the FIFO after matching accepted but before begin_model_turn?
runtime: CPython 3.11 on Windows; in-memory FIFO only
monitor_rule: Sequence 9 yields hard_health_loss; any other row yields no invalidation.

decision.pass: the controller observes sequence 9 and prevents begin_model_turn from starting
decision.fail: either source returns accepted, then begin_model_turn occurs before the monitor observes sequence 9
decision.hold: frozen source identities or event order do not match

scope: Deterministic synthetic ordering only. No cover, model, game, X server, OS input, allocation, latency, or task effect.
